suno-ai.title: Suno AI Mastering: Elevate AI Tracks to Studio Standards | MASTR
suno-ai.description: Eliminate synthetic harshness, reconstruct punchy sub-bass, and bring your Suno AI music to competitive radio and Spotify volume.
suno-ai.intro: Suno generates brilliant compositions but often suffers from hollow sub-bass and harsh metallic trebles. Our purpose-trained AI mastering engine cures audio artifacts and injects analog warmth.
suno-ai.problemDesc: AI audio generators output heavily compressed files with fizzy top ends and muddy low-mids that sound thin on club PAs and studio monitors.
suno-ai.solutionDesc: With specialized de-harshing, sub-harmonic bass synthesis, and dynamic multiband compression, your Suno songs sound studio-finished.
suno-ai.faq1Q: Can I import tracks directly via Suno URL?
suno-ai.faq1A: Yes! Paste any public Suno song link into our player input, and MASTR extracts the track in highest available bit rate.
suno-ai.faq2Q: Is the master ready for Spotify and Apple Music?
suno-ai.faq2A: Yes, you download pristine 24-bit WAV files mastered to -14 LUFS or -8.5 LUFS meeting all distributor delivery specifications.

house-music.title: House & EDM Mastering Online: Peak Club Punch | MASTR
house-music.description: Loud, transparent mastering for club releases. Hit -8.5 LUFS without distortion while keeping clean kick-bass separation.
house-music.intro: From deep house to festival techno: give your drops thunderous low-end weight and wide stereo imaging that cuts through massive club sound systems.
house-music.problemTitle: Why Electronic Music Demands Specialized Mastering
house-music.problemDesc: Deep sub-frequencies quickly eat headroom. Over-compression causes muddy pumping and drains groove momentum.
house-music.solutionDesc: Our Club & EDM preset centers sub-bass mono while enhancing stereo width and high-frequency sparkle with zero phase cancellation.
house-music.faq1A: Yes, frequencies below 100 Hz are centered in mono to prevent phase issues on large club subwoofer arrays.
house-music.faq2Q: How loud will my master be?
house-music.faq2A: The Club preset targets -8.5 to -7.5 LUFS with strict True-Peak compliance at -0.3 dBFS.

hip-hop-beats.title: Hip-Hop & Trap Beat Mastering Online | MASTR
hip-hop-beats.description: Earth-shaking 808s, snappy snares, and vocal headroom. The dedicated mastering studio for beatmakers and artists.
hip-hop-beats.intro: Ensure your 808s hit hard across smartphone speakers, car sound systems, and studio monitors without drowning out vocals.
hip-hop-beats.problemDesc: Excessive or distorted 808 bass triggers clunky limiter action, leading to flat, squashed drums.
hip-hop-beats.solutionDesc: MASTR injects strategic overtones so deep sub frequencies register clearly on small speakers while transient attacks stay crisp.
hip-hop-beats.faq1Q: Does this work on tracks with recorded vocals?
hip-hop-beats.faq1A: Absolutely. Use the Vocal Clarity slider in Pro Mode to keep vocal performances focused and upfront.
hip-hop-beats.faq2Q: Can I export stems or BeatStars-ready files?
hip-hop-beats.faq2A: Yes, MASTR generates 24-bit WAV files ready for commercial licensing, distribution, and leasing platforms.

podcasts.title: Podcast & Voice Mastering Online | MASTR
podcasts.description: Consistent speech volume, room noise attenuation, and crystal-clear vocal presence for podcasts and audiobooks.
podcasts.intro: Deliver balanced speaker levels, intimate proximity tone, and strict broadcast standard compliance (-16 LUFS stereo / -19 LUFS mono).
podcasts.problemDesc: Varying recording distances and microphone differences cause listener fatigue over long listening sessions.
podcasts.solutionDesc: Intelligent leveling automatically balances conversational dynamics and tames harsh sibilance for smooth listening.
podcasts.faq1Q: What loudness standard is applied for podcasts?
podcasts.faq1A: We master spoken content strictly to the international podcast standard: -16 LUFS for stereo and -19 LUFS for mono.
podcasts.faq2A: Spectral noise floor attenuation gently reduces room resonance and constant ambient hum.
